dormitories.summary: A 1,200-bed dormitory serving the Tuas industrial belt, with dedicated recreation decks and on-site security. The dormitory comes with cooking facilities for residences to use.
dormitories.name: Tuas Seatown Dormitory
writeup: Tuas Seatown Dormitory was designed to house workers from the surrounding marine and heavy industrial cluster, with easy access to major yards along Tuas South Avenue.
Every block is organised around a central recreation courtyard, with cross-ventilated rooms, dedicated cooking decks, and a 24-hour on-site security.
The dormitory operates under a structured welfare framework, with regular facility audits and a resident feedback channel managed directly by our operations team.

dormitories.summary: A newer-generation dormitory in central Singapore, built to the new regulations with all ensuite bedrooms.
dormitories.name: Tannery Lodge I & II
writeup: Tannery Lodge I & II opened in 2025 and reflects the latest generation of purpose-built worker housing, with ensuite toilets in all rooms.
The site sits within the Macpherson industrial estate and offers great connectivity to job sites around Singapore.

dormitories.summary: One of our earlier developments, fully upgraded in 2023 with new kitchen decks and expanded recreation space.
dormitories.name: Jurong Central Block
writeup: Jurong Central Block has housed workers from the surrounding port and processing industries since 2017, and underwent a full facilities upgrade in 2023.
The refurbishment added a second recreation deck, expanded wet-kitchen capacity, and replaced all room lighting and ventilation fittings.
Its location places most major Jurong-area worksites within a short shuttle ride, reducing daily commute time for residents.
